title: English Practice Quiz 0555
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.
